scope.input: Cycle 3 q=ceil((5N-1)/2) rational Bernoulli atoms p_i in (0,1), positive rational weights mu_i, with uniform relative error epsilon/4
scope.output: q(N+1) pure N-fold product states over Q(i), positive rational weights, exactly normalized and with no support outside the symmetric subspace
explicit_exclusions: exact rational product decomposition of rho_N
per-sector relative error after local amplitude or phase perturbations
full computational-basis diagonal operator with per-string weights f_|x|
downstream AP algorithm or hardness transfer
external proof review, novelty, or priority claim

claims.claim: Uniform N+1 roots-of-unity twirling of an N-fold identical qubit product gives exactly sum_k B_(N,k)(p)|D_k><D_k|.
claims.evidence: RESULT.txt Section 2; exact N=3 matrix diagnostic

claims.claim: Normalizing the Cycle 3 positive scalar mixture changes the target Dicke-diagonal state by trace distance at most epsilon/(4-epsilon) <= 2 epsilon/7.
Rational Pythagorean local amplitudes obtained by exact bisection add at most epsilon/4 trace distance.
Rational unit-circle phases z^j in Q(i), with a rationally approximated phase generator, add at most epsilon/4 trace distance.
The rationalized finite ensemble is exactly normalized, has positive rational weights, and has exact support only in the symmetric subspace.
The Dicke-sector coefficient includes binom(N,k), whereas each computational string diagonal entry is the sector coefficient divided by binom(N,k).
The scalar rational positive mixture with q=Theta(N) atoms and polynomial bit construction exists in the stated regime.

finite_evidence.scope: Exact Fraction arithmetic over Q(i), N=3, two hand-chosen rational Pythagorean atoms, all 64 computational matrix entries

does not test the approximate phase routine numerically for general N
